unlisted_practices: Clinician-guided entity guidelines in prompts to improve extraction accuracy
Few-shot examples in prompts to improve extraction accuracy
Disagreement modelling to prioritise reports for clinical review
Running small language models on CPU-only local infrastructure to avoid sending clinical data to cloud services

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a semi-automated clinical NLP annotation workflow using small language models, specifically testing prompting practices (entity guidelines, few-shot prompting) and a disagreement modelling framework to prioritize cases for clinician review.

primary.practice: clinician-guided entity guidelines and few-shot grounding with disagreement-based prioritization for human review
